description: This file defines an Android activity `AnimateDrawables` that demonstrates animating drawable resources by applying translation animation to a drawable within a custom View (`SampleView`). It sets up the animation and rendering logic for demonstrating animated drawables on the screen.

classes.name: AnimateDrawables
classes.description: Main activity class that sets up the animated drawable demonstration.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View class that performs drawing and animation of the drawable.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and sets the custom view layout.

methods.name: SampleView
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the drawable and animation.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the drawing method to render the animated drawable.
